evals.prompt: lay out the VPC subnets and CIDR ranges for a new account
evals.expected_output: Plans CIDR ranges with headroom for future subnets before provisioning, checks against every network it may ever need to peer with, and separates public subnets (load balancers, NAT/bastion) from private subnets by function.

evals.prompt: our app in the private subnet can't reach the S3 bucket
evals.expected_output: Checks whether traffic is being routed to the public internet via NAT instead of a private endpoint/private-link, and recommends using a private endpoint so managed-service traffic never traverses the public internet.

evals.prompt: just open egress to all outbound traffic so nothing breaks, we'll lock it down later
evals.expected_output: Pushes back that egress should default to deny with explicit allow-listed destinations, especially for sensitive workloads, since outbound is the exact path exfiltration and compromised dependencies use and rarely gets revisited once open.
